_readme: This is a STARTER set of 6 examples built from the sample_docs/ included in this repo, purely so the eval harness runs out of the box. Before you put this project on your resume, replace this with 30-50 questions you write BY HAND against YOUR OWN documents. That's the whole point of the exercise: retrieval precision and groundedness numbers are only meaningful when the questions weren't written by the same pipeline you're testing.

cases.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
What is the maximum weight the SR-40 drone can carry?
Who do employees contact to enroll in the 401k plan?
What is the flight time of the SR-40 drone on a single charge?
How many sick days do employees receive per year?
What is the maximum flight altitude of the SR-40 drone?
